-- Generated by clinical:generate; do not edit. No production application authorized.
-- clinical lab_reference is the inherited clinical band, NOT a patient's lab interval.
-- Seed SHA-256: __HASH__
BEGIN;
SET LOCAL standard_conforming_strings = on;
SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, public;
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(20261006, 41);
DO $clinical$
DECLARE
  seed jsonb := __PAYLOAD__;
  rel text;
  actual jsonb;
  expected jsonb;
  old_rows jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  after_rows jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  archived_rows jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  saved record;
  bad record;
  run_mode text;
  legacy text[] := ARRAY['biomarker_definitions','biomarker_reference_ranges','biomarker_phase_ranges'];
  present text[];
  absent_legacy text[];
  legacy_oids oid[];
  conflict_drift boolean;
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('clinical_archive.task041_state') IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO STRICT saved FROM clinical_archive.task041_state;
    IF saved.seed_hash <> '__HASH__' OR saved.status <> 'applied' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 incompatible catalog or rolled-back state; explicit new migration required';
    END IF;
    IF saved.absent_legacy IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY(SELECT x FROM unnest(legacy) x WHERE NOT (saved.archived_rows ? x) ORDER BY x)
      OR (saved.mode, cardinality(saved.absent_legacy)) NOT IN (('production',0),('chain',1),('absent',3))
      OR (saved.mode='chain' AND saved.absent_legacy <> ARRAY['biomarker_phase_ranges']) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 recorded mode % does not match its archived tables', saved.mode;
    END IF;
    FOREACH rel IN ARRAY ARRAY['canonical_analytes','analyte_synonyms','biomarker_catalog','clinical_catalog_entries','clinical_ranges'] LOOP
      EXECUTE format('LOCK TABLE public.%I IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE', rel);
      EXECUTE format('SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text), ''[]''::jsonb) FROM public.%I t', rel) INTO actual;
      IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM saved.after_rows->rel THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 intervening writes in %', rel; END IF;
    END LOOP;
    FOREACH rel IN ARRAY legacy LOOP
      IF to_regclass('public.' || rel) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 duplicate legacy table %', rel; END IF;
      IF NOT (saved.archived_rows ? rel) THEN
        IF to_regclass('clinical_archive.' || rel) IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 unexpected archive %',rel; END IF;
        CONTINUE;
      END IF;
      EXECUTE format('LOCK TABLE clinical_archive.%I IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE', rel);
      EXECUTE format('SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text), ''[]''::jsonb) FROM clinical_archive.%I t', rel) INTO actual;
      IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM saved.archived_rows->rel THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 changed archive %', rel; END IF;
    END LOOP;
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  -- Classify before reading or writing anything (Lead amendment 4):
  --   production: all three legacy tables; the only mode permitted against production.
  --   chain: definitions + reference ranges, phase ranges absent (a fresh checked-in chain).
  --   absent: no legacy table (turn-3 case, retained).
  -- Every other shape is unclassifiable and refuses.
  IF to_regnamespace('clinical_archive') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 unclassifiable state: schema clinical_archive exists without applied state';
  END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.clinical_ranges') IS NOT NULL OR to_regclass('public.clinical_catalog_entries') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 unclassifiable state: destination clinical tables already exist';
  END IF;
  SELECT c.relname, c.relkind INTO bad FROM unnest(legacy) name JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=to_regclass('public.' || name)
    WHERE c.relkind <> 'r' ORDER BY c.relname LIMIT 1;
  IF FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 unclassifiable legacy state: public.% has relkind %, not an ordinary table', bad.relname, bad.relkind;
  END IF;
  present := ARRAY(SELECT name FROM unnest(legacy) name WHERE to_regclass('public.' || name) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name);
  absent_legacy := ARRAY(SELECT name FROM unnest(legacy) name WHERE to_regclass('public.' || name) IS NULL ORDER BY name);
  run_mode := CASE
    WHEN cardinality(present)=3 THEN 'production'
    WHEN present=ARRAY['biomarker_definitions','biomarker_reference_ranges'] THEN 'chain'
    WHEN cardinality(present)=0 THEN 'absent'
  END;
  IF run_mode IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 unclassifiable legacy state: present % is neither production (all three), chain (definitions and reference ranges without phase ranges) nor absent (none)', present;
  END IF;
  FOREACH rel IN ARRAY ARRAY['canonical_analytes','analyte_synonyms','biomarker_catalog'] || present LOOP
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE oid=to_regclass('public.' || rel) AND relkind='r') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode %: missing ordinary table %', run_mode, rel;
    END IF;
    EXECUTE format('LOCK TABLE public.%I IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE', rel);
    EXECUTE format('SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text), ''[]''::jsonb) FROM public.%I t', rel) INTO actual;
    IF rel = ANY(legacy) THEN
      archived_rows := archived_rows || jsonb_build_object(rel, actual);
    ELSE
      old_rows := old_rows || jsonb_build_object(rel, actual);
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  legacy_oids := ARRAY(SELECT to_regclass('public.' || name)::oid FROM unnest(present) name);
  -- Never silently archive an unexpected external dependent table or view.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype='f'
    AND confrelid = ANY(legacy_oids) AND conrelid <> ALL(legacy_oids)
    AND NOT (conname='lab_results_biomarker_name_fkey' AND conrelid=coalesce(to_regclass('public.lab_results'),0::oid)
      AND confrelid=to_regclass('public.biomarker_definitions'))
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_rewrite w ON d.classid='pg_rewrite'::regclass AND d.objid=w.oid
    WHERE d.refobjid = ANY(legacy_oids)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode %: unexpected legacy dependency', run_mode; END IF;
  IF run_mode='production' THEN
    IF jsonb_array_length(archived_rows->'biomarker_definitions') <> 44
      OR jsonb_array_length(archived_rows->'biomarker_reference_ranges') <> 23
      OR jsonb_array_length(archived_rows->'biomarker_phase_ranges') <> 22 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode production: unexpected legacy row counts';
    END IF;
    -- Lead-supplied 2026-10-06 inventories are preconditions, not winners.
    -- Refuse changed known conflicts rather than silently archiving new evidence.
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.biomarker_definitions WHERE name='magnesium' AND unit='mg/dL'
        AND optimal_min=5.2 AND optimal_max=6.5 AND clinical_min=4.2 AND clinical_max=6.8)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.biomarker_definitions WHERE name='egfr' AND unit='mL/min'
        AND optimal_min=90 AND optimal_max=120 AND clinical_min=60 AND clinical_max=120) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode production: definitions inventory mismatch';
    END IF;
    -- Dynamic SQL: the other modes never plan a reference to an absent phase table.
    EXECUTE 'SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES
        (''estradiol'',''follicular'',30,250,30,200,20,400,12,300),
        (''estradiol'',''luteal'',50,300,60,200,30,500,12,250),
        (''estradiol'',''menstrual'',20,80,20,80,10,200,12,100),
        (''estradiol'',''ovulatory'',150,750,150,350,100,1000,100,500),
        (''fsh'',''follicular'',2,10,3,10,2,20,2,20),
        (''fsh'',''luteal'',1,8,1,8,1,10,1,12),
        (''fsh'',''menstrual'',3,10,3,10,3,20,2,20),
        (''fsh'',''ovulatory'',2,15,6,20,2,30,5,30),
        (''lh'',''follicular'',2,15,1,12,1,25,1,15),
        (''lh'',''luteal'',2,12,1,10,1,20,1,15),
        (''lh'',''menstrual'',2,15,1,10,1,25,1,15),
        (''lh'',''ovulatory'',20,80,15,70,15,100,10,100),
        (''progesterone'',''follicular'',0.1,0.9,0.1,1.0,0.1,1.5,0.1,1.5),
        (''progesterone'',''luteal'',5.0,25.0,5.0,20.0,3.0,30.0,2.0,25.0),
        (''progesterone'',''menstrual'',0.1,0.9,0.1,0.9,0.1,1.5,0.1,1.0)
      ) v(slug,phase,ro_min,ro_max,po_min,po_max,rc_min,rc_max,pc_min,pc_max)
      LEFT JOIN public.biomarker_reference_ranges r ON r.biomarker_name=v.slug AND r.phase=v.phase
      LEFT JOIN public.biomarker_phase_ranges p ON p.biomarker_name=v.slug AND p.phase=v.phase
      WHERE ROW(r.optimal_min,r.optimal_max,r.clinical_min,r.clinical_max) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(v.ro_min,v.ro_max,v.rc_min,v.rc_max)
         OR ROW(p.optimal_min,p.optimal_max,p.clinical_min,p.clinical_max) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(v.po_min,v.po_max,v.pc_min,v.pc_max)
    )' INTO STRICT conflict_drift;
    IF conflict_drift THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode production: phase conflict inventory mismatch'; END IF;
  END IF;
  -- Production and absent modes treat the supplied snapshots as the exact metadata
  -- precondition, not permission to overwrite drift. Chain mode is a clean
  -- developer database and nothing in it is evidence: it asserts no row counts or
  -- conflict inventories and lets the upserts below seed by slug. It still refuses
  -- a seeded synonym owned by a different analyte (Lead turn-6 ruling): ON CONFLICT
  -- DO NOTHING would otherwise keep that wrong extraction mapping silently. Extra
  -- and missing synonyms are allowed.
  IF run_mode = 'chain' THEN
    SELECT s.synonym_text, s.source_type, a.slug AS owner, x->>'analyte_slug' AS seeded INTO bad
      FROM public.analyte_synonyms s JOIN public.canonical_analytes a ON a.id=s.canonical_analyte_id
      JOIN jsonb_array_elements(seed->'synonyms') x ON x->>'synonym_text'=s.synonym_text AND x->>'source_type'=s.source_type
      WHERE a.slug <> x->>'analyte_slug' ORDER BY s.synonym_text, s.source_type LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode chain: conflicting synonym owner: % (%) is owned by %, seed says %',
        bad.synonym_text, bad.source_type, bad.owner, bad.seeded;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF run_mode IN ('production','absent') THEN
    SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x::text) INTO expected FROM jsonb_array_elements(seed->'registry') x;
    SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)-'id'-'created_at' ORDER BY (to_jsonb(t)-'id'-'created_at')::text) INTO actual FROM public.canonical_analytes t;
    IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode %: canonical snapshot mismatch', run_mode; END IF;
    SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x::text) INTO expected FROM jsonb_array_elements(seed->'metadata') x;
    SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)-'id'-'created_at' ORDER BY (to_jsonb(t)-'id'-'created_at')::text) INTO actual FROM public.biomarker_catalog t;
    IF actual IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode %: catalog snapshot mismatch', run_mode; END IF;
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.analyte_synonyms s JOIN public.canonical_analytes a ON a.id=s.canonical_analyte_id
      WHERE NOT (seed->'synonyms' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('analyte_slug',a.slug,'synonym_text',s.synonym_text,'source_type',s.source_type)))
    ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'TASK-041 mode %: unrecognized synonym or conflicting owner', run_mode; END IF;
  END IF;

  CREATE SCHEMA clinical_archive;
  REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA clinical_archive FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
  CREATE TABLE clinical_archive.task041_state (
    singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK(singleton), seed_hash text NOT NULL,
    status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('applied','rolled_back')),
    mode text NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('production','chain','absent')), absent_legacy text[] NOT NULL,
    before_rows jsonb NOT NULL, after_rows jsonb NOT NULL, archived_rows jsonb NOT NULL
  );
  REVOKE ALL ON clinical_archive.task041_state FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated, service_role;
  ALTER TABLE clinical_archive.task041_state ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

  -- Seed by slug. In production and absent modes the exact-state guards above make
  -- these identity/catalog upserts precondition-only no-ops, preserving IDs and
  -- timestamps. Only chain mode can insert missing rows; rollback deletes them.
  INSERT INTO public.canonical_analytes (slug,display_name,category,subcategory,unit,is_core,is_ratio,affects_scoring,affects_recommendations)
    SELECT x.slug,x.display_name,x.category,x.subcategory,x.unit,x.is_core,x.is_ratio,x.affects_scoring,x.affects_recommendations
    FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.canonical_analytes,seed->'registry') x
    ON CONFLICT(slug) DO NOTHING;
  INSERT INTO public.biomarker_catalog (slug,name,category,subcategory,unit,sex_applicability,is_cycle_dependent,is_fasting_sensitive)
    SELECT x.slug,x.name,x.category,x.subcategory,x.unit,x.sex_applicability,x.is_cycle_dependent,x.is_fasting_sensitive
    FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.biomarker_catalog,seed->'metadata') x
    ON CONFLICT(slug) DO NOTHING;
  INSERT INTO public.analyte_synonyms (canonical_analyte_id,synonym_text,source_type)
    SELECT a.id,s->>'synonym_text',s->>'source_type' FROM jsonb_array_elements(seed->'synonyms') s
    JOIN public.canonical_analytes a ON a.slug=s->>'analyte_slug'
    ON CONFLICT(synonym_text,source_type) DO NOTHING;

  -- Separate catalog identity preserves two range-only analytes without creating
  -- extraction identities. Unreconciled units have NULL registry_slug/factor.
  -- Everything from here on is mode-independent: every mode builds identical tables.
  CREATE TABLE public.clinical_catalog_entries (
    slug text PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE(slug,range_unit), legacy_key text UNIQUE NOT NULL, range_unit text NOT NULL,
    registry_slug text REFERENCES public.canonical_analytes(slug), registry_unit text,
    legacy_to_registry_factor numeric, metadata jsonb NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((registry_slug IS NULL AND legacy_to_registry_factor IS NULL) OR
      (registry_slug IS NOT NULL AND registry_slug=slug AND registry_unit IS NOT NULL AND legacy_to_registry_factor IS NOT NULL AND legacy_to_registry_factor>0))
  );
  CREATE TABLE public.clinical_ranges (
    slug text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.clinical_catalog_entries(slug),
    population text NOT NULL CHECK(population IN ('general','female_adult','male_adult','pregnancy_t1','pregnancy_t2','pregnancy_t3','postpartum','postmenopausal')),
    phase text CHECK(phase IN ('general','menstrual','follicular','ovulatory','luteal')),
    kind text NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('lab_reference','amani_context')),
    candidate_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'shipping' CHECK(candidate_id ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'), unit text NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY(slug,unit) REFERENCES public.clinical_catalog_entries(slug,range_unit),
    min numeric, max numeric, source text, source_url text, source_date text,
    evidence_grade text NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_grade IN ('A','B','C','expert_opinion','unsourced')),
    review_status text NOT NULL CHECK(review_status IN ('SAFE','NEEDS_CONTEXT','DISPUTED','UNKNOWN')),
    reviewer text, reviewed_at text, version integer NOT NULL CHECK(version>0), notes text NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT clinical_ranges_identity UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (slug,population,phase,kind,candidate_id),
    CHECK(min IS NULL OR max IS NULL OR min<=max),
    CHECK(source_date IS NULL OR source_date ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'),
    CHECK(reviewed_at IS NULL OR reviewed_at ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'),
    CHECK((evidence_grade='unsourced' AND source IS NULL AND source_url IS NULL AND source_date IS NULL) OR
      (evidence_grade<>'unsourced' AND source IS NOT NULL AND source !~ '^[[:space:]]*$' AND source_date IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK(review_status<>'SAFE' OR (evidence_grade<>'unsourced' AND reviewer IS NOT NULL AND reviewer !~ '^[[:space:]]*$' AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK((candidate_id='shipping' AND population='general' AND review_status<>'DISPUTED') OR
      (candidate_id<>'shipping' AND review_status='DISPUTED'))
  );
  COMMENT ON COLUMN public.clinical_ranges.unit IS 'Endpoints use shipping/client units. Convert using explicit clinical_catalog_entries factor before comparing registry units.';
  COMMENT ON COLUMN public.clinical_ranges.kind IS 'lab_reference transcribes legacy clinical, not a patient laboratory interval. Neither kind implies evidence or optimal eligibility.';
  INSERT INTO public.clinical_catalog_entries SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.clinical_catalog_entries,seed->'entries');
  INSERT INTO public.clinical_ranges SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_recordset(NULL::public.clinical_ranges,seed->'ranges');
  ALTER TABLE public.clinical_catalog_entries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
  ALTER TABLE public.clinical_ranges ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
  REVOKE ALL ON public.clinical_catalog_entries,public.clinical_ranges FROM PUBLIC,anon,authenticated,service_role;
  GRANT SELECT ON public.clinical_catalog_entries,public.clinical_ranges TO authenticated,service_role;
  CREATE POLICY clinical_entries_read ON public.clinical_catalog_entries FOR SELECT TO authenticated,service_role USING(true);
  CREATE POLICY clinical_ranges_read ON public.clinical_ranges FOR SELECT TO authenticated,service_role USING(true);

  FOREACH rel IN ARRAY present LOOP
    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE public.%I SET SCHEMA clinical_archive',rel);
  END LOOP;
  FOREACH rel IN ARRAY ARRAY['canonical_analytes','analyte_synonyms','biomarker_catalog','clinical_catalog_entries','clinical_ranges'] LOOP
    EXECUTE format('SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY to_jsonb(t)::text), ''[]''::jsonb) FROM public.%I t',rel) INTO actual;
    after_rows := after_rows || jsonb_build_object(rel,actual);
  END LOOP;
  INSERT INTO clinical_archive.task041_state(seed_hash,status,mode,absent_legacy,before_rows,after_rows,archived_rows)
    VALUES('__HASH__','applied',run_mode,absent_legacy,old_rows,after_rows,archived_rows);
END $clinical$;
COMMIT;
